verdict: Leads nearly doubled week-over-week; setup milestones remain significantly overdue.
narrative: In the last 28 days you received 32 leads from Meta at a cost per lead of $6.16 — a 91% jump in lead volume week-over-week on nearly the same spend, meaning the ad creative and audience targeting are genuinely performing more efficiently. That said, several foundational pieces of your program — including landing pages, conversion tracking, and search campaigns — remain undelivered well past their agreed dates, which means this lead volume exists without a full-funnel structure behind it. Conversion tracking is being repaired, so lead quality cannot be fully verified yet. Getting those outstanding milestones closed is the immediate priority heading into October, and as each one comes live you'll have a much clearer picture of which leads are converting to appointments.
